description: This file contains functions for managing browser profile decorations, including reading/writing JSON configs, setting deep object properties, parsing color values, and decorating profiles with specific names and colors in a browser environment.

methods.name: decoratedMarkerPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the profile decoration marker file.

methods.name: safeReadJson
methods.description: Safely reads and parses a JSON file, returning null on failure.

methods.name: safeWriteJson
methods.description: Safely writes a JSON object to a file, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: setDeep
methods.description: Sets a nested property in an object, creating intermediate objects if necessary.

methods.name: parseHexRgbToSignedArgbInt
methods.description: Converts a hex RGB color string to a signed ARGB integer.
